scope: BMI three-model development CV with unpenalized demographics; no test evaluation
regularization: OLS demographics unpenalized; training-fold StandardScaler on audio; residualize BOTH y and scaled X against training-fold C; Ridge only on residual audio

permutation_diagnostic.method: shuffle BMI within sex across development speakers
permutation_diagnostic.interpretation: descriptive sanity diagnostic, NOT a leakage proof or formal conditional-on-age null test; preserves sex groups but destroys age-BMI relation

sex_diagnostic.evaluation: same saved development CV folds, out-of-fold predictions only
sex_diagnostic.scaling: fit StandardScaler on each training fold only
sex_diagnostic.convergence_warning_policy: fail diagnosis; do not silently report nonconverged classifier

cv_scores_are: development selection scores; optimistically biased by alpha selection; not final generalization estimates
pre_fit_clarifications: sex diagnosis uses same saved OOF folds with train-fold scaling
save full fold IDs and protocol lock before first fit
reject demographic rank deficiency and logistic convergence warnings
demographic_rank_deficiency_policy: fail if training design rank is less than 3
